principles: DONE output must be based on durable frozen facts, not recomputed active-story freshness.
Active story milestone_status must keep live freshness checks.
Read-only commands must stay side-effect free in text and JSON modes.
Developer-facing tables should keep the same three-section Milestone Status layout and status icons.
drivers: B-e62e DONE transcript showed a false red table immediately after successful DONE.
milestone-closeout.json already has the accepted completed snapshot.
The fix must be small enough to complete through validation and review quickly.

options.name: snapshot-to-status-report
pros: Keeps milestone_status command and three-section renderer consistent for DONE stories
Works for text and JSON output without adding another bespoke table
Can reuse closeout rows while avoiding live evidence binding after cleanup
cons: Requires mapping closeout rows back into a MilestoneStatusReport shape

options.name: print-closeout-text-after-done
pros: Very small change in post-command append path
Uses the existing milestone_closeout renderer directly
cons: Does not fix lattice milestone_status --storyId on DONE stories
Output would not be the requested Completed/Current/Remaining Milestone Status table

options.name: ignore-stale-after-done
cons: Risks masking real missing closeout and weakens the live projection model

rationale: Use the frozen closeout snapshot as the DONE source of truth while preserving the normal Milestone Status table contract and live checks for active stories.

preMortem.scenario: DONE story without milestone-closeout.json is shown as completed anyway
preMortem.trigger: Fallback path treats any DONE phase as trustworthy
preMortem.consequence: CLI fabricates success and hides missing closeout evidence
preMortem.mitigation: Only use the frozen path when a schema-valid milestone-closeout.json exists; otherwise retain fail-closed diagnostics.

preMortem.scenario: Active stories stop detecting stale evidence
preMortem.trigger: Closeout fallback runs before checking the story phase or snapshot presence
preMortem.consequence: DEV/REVIEW users see green rows despite stale or missing evidence
preMortem.mitigation: Gate the fallback to phase DONE plus valid snapshot only, and add an active-story regression.

preMortem.trigger: Text-only conversion or closeout snapshot returned from milestone_status JSON
preMortem.consequence: Consumers of milestone_status JSON break or lose groups/completed/current/remaining fields
preMortem.mitigation: Return a MilestoneStatusReport-shaped object for snapshot-backed DONE status and test JSON fields.
